_about: George Henry Lewes (1817-1878): The Physical Basis of Mind (Boston: Houghton Mifflin, 1891; clean Gutenberg text) and The History of Philosophy from Thales to Comte (London: Longmans, Green; raw IA OCR). The two History volumes are from different editions: vol. I is the 3rd edition (the OCR reads the year as 1807; it is 1867) and vol. II the 4th edition of 1871. A matched pair would replace them. US public domain. No uids minted.
